name: epsilon
description: Trade on Robinhood Chain from your agent: limit orders, stop-losses, and DCA on memecoins, RWAs, and majors — get quotes, place and cancel orders, track your portfolio in chat. Non-custodial (signed locally, funds stay in your wallet) with spend caps and order confirmations. Also skills for building bots and apps on the Epsilon REST API and TypeScript/Python SDKs.

EPSILON_API_KEY.title: Epsilon API key
EPSILON_API_KEY.description: Free self-serve key (eps_…) from https://developers.epsilon.exchange/dashboard. Required for quotes, market data, and orders.

EPSILON_WALLET_KEY.title: Trading wallet private key (optional)
EPSILON_WALLET_KEY.description: 0x-prefixed private key of a DEDICATED trading wallet with limited funds — never your main wallet. Leave empty for read-only mode (quotes and market data only). Orders are signed locally; the key never leaves your machine.

EPSILON_REFERRER.title: Rev-share payout address (optional)
EPSILON_REFERRER.description: 0x address that earns the on-chain referral leg of fills routed through this plugin (permissionless rev-share).
